title: Dissection and fixation of murine colonic tissue
author: Dante Heredia
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xz6fp9e

steps.title: Incise and excise colon
steps.instruction: Make a ventral midline incision, carefully excise the whole colon, and place it into a Sylguard‑lined dissection dish.

steps.title: Open colon longitudinally
steps.instruction: Cut along the mesenteric border until the colon tube opens and becomes rectangular in shape.

steps.title: Pin colon and remove mucosa
steps.instruction: Pin the colon mucosa‑side up at 110 % of its original length and width, gently peel off the mucosal layer, then transfer the tissue to a new Sylguard‑lined dish and re‑pin at 100 % ensuring it is taut but not stretched.

substeps.instruction: Pin at 110 % length and width, mucosa side up.
Re‑pin in a new Sylguard dish at 100 % without overstretching.

steps.title: Fix tissue in Zamboni
steps.instruction: Fix the tissue in ice‑cold Zamboni fixative for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Wash tissue in PBS
steps.instruction: Remove the tissue from the dish and wash it three times in PBS, each wash lasting 15 minutes.

steps.title: Section and mount tissue
steps.instruction: Cut the tissue into three sections (oral, middle, anal) to fit on a slide, mount each section on a glass slide using Aquamount mounting media, and place a glass cover slip over the preparation.

substeps.instruction: Cut into oral, middle, and anal sections.
Mount sections on a glass slide with Aquamount mounting media.

steps.title: Image sample
steps.instruction: Acquire images of the prepared sample.
